intent.subtype: self-referencing assignment that closes a loop only for one value of an input
intent.rationale: y is defined in terms of itself when keep=1 (and load=0); with keep=0 the path is open. Whether the loop is ever sensitised depends on the run-time value of keep, which the file does not constrain.

labels.note: y is a continuous assignment that depends on y itself when keep is set and load is clear.
y is computed from itself via {y[6:0],y[7]} when keep && !load: combinational loop.

settlement.note: y is continuously assigned from y itself through the keep branch: the combinational loop is in the netlist whatever the run-time value of keep.
